text: Do you want to improve digestion and reduce overeating? Before your main meal, give yourself 10 minutes of silence: without rushing, without a phone, without the internet, without conversations “on the run.” Ideally - 10 minutes of meditation. At least the simplest - just sit and look at one point. Watch your breathing so that it is relaxed and at the same time full - both with the belly and with the chest. You will notice the results in just a week - calmness and inner joy will appear, the process of eating will happen differently, and even your diet may change (become healthier).
